title: Exercise — network-society organic alliances (draft, not accepted)
description: Draft bridges from fake-data-generation/brainstorming/README.md. Not loaded by loadSeedCollections. Not accepted into seed-content. No implication attester call has been run. Abortion cutoff and schools-pushing stay in their accepted files and are not rewritten here.
notes: A bridge needs a real concession. Same outcome, different motive, with both sides already willing to sign the outcome, is overlap and is not given a triple.

Skipped as overlap or as a weaker same-conclusion pattern: low-carb enclaves, the unwoke umbrella, Democracy 2.0 as a second voting cause, Christianity crossed with secular conservatives, home-schoolers and school families sharing field-trip notes, and 'both sides already dislike first-past-the-post.'
The accepted immigration cluster is about deportation. The assimilation triple below is about what a local program does. Do not merge them.
The accepted schools cluster is about pushing versus support. The youth-medicine triple below does not settle that, classroom names, or school approval of drugs.

2026-10-16 live attester (deepseek/deepseek-v3.2) blessed commonality to both employment modifieds and each employment modified to the other, and blessed Canada commonality to modified-right. Those modifieds were thickened with a camp priority the commonality does not contain. The Canada commonality dropped 'I'd be okay with saying that'.

groups.title: Grey County practical-English sessions, without a customs program or an origin-language township office

statements.text: I want newcomers in Grey County to be able to learn practical English and how the library, the bus, and a township office work, and I want them to be able to keep their own customs.
If people move to Grey County, they should join the local way of life. I don't want the township running services in origin languages forever.

I want newcomers in Grey County to be able to learn practical English and how the library, the bus, and a township office work, and I want them to be able to keep their own customs. I'd be okay with twelve evening practical-English sessions in Owen Sound, with childcare, that explain those four things, while township business stays in English and the sessions stop short of telling newcomers which customs to keep. groups.title: One non-binding Owen Sound poll that publishes both counts
groups.pattern: different preferred replacements, same limited trial

statements.text: First-past-the-post wastes my vote. I want ranked ballots.
First-past-the-post rewards the biggest camp. I want approval voting, not a ranked system.

First-past-the-post wastes my vote. I want ranked ballots for a real election. I'd be okay with one Owen Sound community association running a non-binding poll and publishing both a ranked count and an approval count of the same ballots. That is not a change to Owen Sound's municipal elections, and publishing the approval count is not me dropping ranked ballots.

groups.title: A three-month Owen Sound checkout trial that still takes cash and cards

statements.text: I want shops to take crypto so a bank can't decide whether a customer gets to pay.
I'm tired of handing three percent of every sale to the card companies.

I want a willing shop and a willing customer to be able to complete a payment when a bank has blocked that customer. Replacing the banks is a bigger thing than this. I'd be okay with six named shops in Owen Sound trying, for three months, a checkout that can take a crypto payment and refund it, show the fee on a twenty-dollar sale before the customer pays, and keep taking cash and ordinary cards the whole time.

groups.title: No cross-sex hormones or genital surgery for minors; adults decide; don't harass people

statements.text: I want a young person in distress about their sex to be able to get medical treatment, including hormones, and I want the rest of us to stop being cruel about it.
I don't want children given drugs or surgery to try to change their sex.

I want adults to make their own medical decisions, and I want disagreeing with someone to not be a reason to harass them. I'd prefer doctors and families to decide about hormones for minors case by case, but I'd be okay with a rule that minors are not given cross-sex hormones or genital surgery, that an adult makes their own medical decision, and that disagreeing with someone is not a reason to harass them. groups.title: An ordinary political opinion, by itself, does not make someone unemployable

statements.text: Nobody should lose their livelihood because they said something unpopular.
Institutions are ending people's careers over ordinary political opinions, and that should stop.

I don't want someone treated as unemployable for an ordinary political opinion. I still want a workplace to respond to threats, to harassment of coworkers, and to someone refusing to do the job. I'd be okay with it if an ordinary political opinion, by itself, were not grounds for treating someone as unemployable, and if threats, harassment of coworkers, and refusing the work still were. I'd still rather a workplace could tell people not to campaign for a candidate while they are on the clock. I feel less strongly about that than about someone losing a livelihood, and I don't have to defend every opinion.

Institutions should stop ending people's careers over ordinary political opinions. I'd still rather a church or a private club could refuse membership over an ordinary political opinion. groups.title: Keep ordinary Canada–US purchases and family visits, without a statement about the administration

statements.text: I don't like Trump, and I still think it's foolish for Canadians to cut off ordinary buying and family visits to the US.
Canada should keep its ordinary ties with the US. There's nothing wrong with that.
